name: funnelzi
author: ainextstudio

sections.description:
No WooCommerce. No shop plugin to install, update or pay for. funnelzi has its own products, orders and checkout, so your funnel is the only thing it adds to your site.

funnelzi builds the whole path of a sale or a sign-up inside WordPress: a landing page, a checkout, an order bump, upsells and downsells, and a thank-you page. Pages are made with the block editor, so you change texts, images and colours as you do on any page.

What you can do

  • Create a funnel from a ready-made template (ten whole funnels, for courses, services, coaching, digital products and free guides) or step by step.
  • Collect payments with Stripe (cards and wallets) and PayPal, inside the funnel, with no redirect to another shop.
  • Add one order bump to the checkout, and upsell and downsell pages after the purchase (one click with cards, a confirmation in the PayPal window with PayPal).
  • Choose the checkout layout: classic, two columns, compact or modern. Give your order bump and your products a picture. Add, reorder and remove checkout fields.
  • Create coupon codes (percentage or fixed amount), share a link ending in ?coupon=CODE, set dates and a maximum number of uses.
  • See orders, refund from the order screen, and let funnelzi send the order emails (buyer confirmation, new-order notice, refund notice) with your site’s email.
  • Collect leads with opt-in forms and multi-step forms or quizzes, give away a lead magnet on the thank-you page, and add a countdown timer (fixed date or evergreen).
  • Add new leads and buyers to a SendFox list, and send every new lead to your CRM, Zapier, Make or n8n with a webhook.
  • Connect your own Meta Pixel, Google Analytics 4 and TikTok Pixel. Nothing is printed until you add an ID.
  • Read simple, anonymous statistics: views per step per day, leads per day. No cookies, no IP address, no user id.

Blocks and shortcodes

Every element of a funnel is available as a block and as a shortcode, so it works with any theme.

Free and Pro

The free plugin builds complete funnels and includes everything above, with a limit of three funnels and one order bump per checkout. A separate add-on plugin, funnelzi Pro, is planned to raise those limits and to add bundles, coupons that also cover upsells and downsells, sending order emails through SendFox, MailerSend or Brevo, and order webhooks. Nothing in this plugin is locked or expires: the Pro code is not part of it, and everything described above works without it.

External services

funnelzi connects to outside services only when you set them up. Nothing is sent before that.

Stripe

Used to take card and wallet payments. When a visitor reaches a checkout, the page loads Stripe’s script from js.stripe.com, and the payment details are sent by the visitor’s browser straight to Stripe. The site sends the amount, the currency, the order number and the buyer’s name and email to api.stripe.com. Needs your own Stripe keys.
Terms of service: https://stripe.com/legal/ssa — Privacy policy: https://stripe.com/privacy

PayPal

Used to take PayPal payments. The page loads PayPal’s script from paypal.com when a checkout is shown, and the site sends the amount, the currency and the order number to api-m.paypal.com (api-m.sandbox.paypal.com in test mode). Needs your own PayPal app keys.
Terms of service: https://www.paypal.com/legalhub/paypal/useragreement-full — Privacy policy: https://www.paypal.com/privacy

SendFox (optional)

If you paste a SendFox token in Settings, the name and email of each new lead and buyer are sent to api.sendfox.com, to the list you chose for that funnel, after the person ticked the consent box.
Terms of service: https://sendfox.com/tos — Privacy policy: https://sendfox.com/privacy

Google Analytics, Meta Pixel and TikTok Pixel (optional)

If you enter an ID in Settings, the matching script is loaded on funnel pages only (googletagmanager.com, connect.facebook.net, analytics.tiktok.com) and reports page views and the standard events Lead, InitiateCheckout and Purchase. You are responsible for asking visitors for consent, as the law of your country requires.
Google: https://policies.google.com/terms and https://policies.google.com/privacy — Meta: https://www.facebook.com/terms and https://www.facebook.com/privacy/policy — TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/legal/terms-of-service and https://www.tiktok.com/legal/privacy-policy

Your own webhook addresses (optional)

If you add addresses in Settings, each new lead is sent there as JSON.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install it from the Plugins screen, and activate it.
  2. Open funnelzi in the admin menu and choose a template, or start from scratch.
  3. In Settings, connect Stripe and/or PayPal, then open your funnel and edit each page.
sections.faq:
Do I need WooCommerce?

No. funnelzi has its own products, orders and checkout, so you do not need WooCommerce or any other shop plugin. If you already use WooCommerce for a shop, funnelzi runs next to it and does not touch it.

Which payment methods can I use?

Stripe (cards and wallets, and other methods if you turn them on) and PayPal. You use your own accounts and keys; the money goes straight to you.

Does it work with any theme or page builder?

Funnel pages are made with the block editor and funnelzi blocks and shortcodes, so they work with any theme.

Is there a limit in the free plugin?

Three funnels and one order bump per checkout. Funnels you already built never stop working.

Does funnelzi track my visitors?

Not on its own. It counts page views per step per day, with no cookies and no personal data. Marketing pixels are loaded only if you add your own IDs.

Where is the data stored?

Leads and orders are stored in your own WordPress database. They are sent to a service only if you connect it.

Can I add upsells to every product?

Yes. After the checkout you can place one or more upsell and downsell pages. With cards the customer accepts or declines with one click, without typing the payment details again; with PayPal they confirm in the PayPal window.
sections.changelog:
1.2.0

  • Add-ons can now draw the checkout, the offer buttons and the order summary of a step, and report a sale to your tracking pixels.
  • The order code keeps travelling from step to step when an add-on keeps its own orders.
  • Services that are plugins on the same site (such as FluentCRM in funnelzi Pro) show a clearer connection text.
  • More currencies for your products: AUD, CAD, CHF, CZK, DKK, NOK, NZD, PLN and SEK, next to euro, dollar and pound.

1.1.2

  • Add-ons can now follow the order of the checkout in progress and create single-use coupons.

1.1.1

  • The file of a product you sell now shows as a download link in the order email and on the thank-you page.

1.1.0

  • New funnel canvas: every page shows its thumbnail, its visits and the share of visitors who move on to the next step. The zoom stays where you set it, and you can type the value.
  • New Email step: send the people who say No, or every lead, to your mailing tool right from the canvas.
  • Checkout consent: for each funnel choose to ask for it, make it optional or hide it.
  • The Modern checkout layout now shows the order bump picture.
  • A wider canvas with a compact header, and the funnel name shows in full.

1.0.0

  • First public release.
